policy.sampling: every original color frame, native nominal10Hz; preserve dropped frames and timestamp gaps
policy.depth: nearest camera depth bag timestamp <=25ms; otherwise explicit zero/missing depth, RGB frame retained
policy.native_backend: existing unchanged ORB-SLAM3 RGBD, original-timestamp pacing

configurations.name: fallback2000
configurations.run_if: either baseline robot fails; run both robots without changing frames

policy.selection: first shared configuration passing on BOTH robots; no GT
policy.reset_policy: map ID + initial-keyframe ID fingerprint; track gaps separately; never connect reset gauges
policy.fusion: only after both robots pass the shared configuration; new camera-only candidates and RGB-D geometry, no historical LiDAR loops
